svg.title: OSW 56 COAST-OWNED STATES study
svg.desc: An ocean-first map in which eleven provisional OSW organizational realms contain 22 contiguous schematic regions and 56 classic province identities. Region membership is connected before land masking; visible pieces can be separated by continents. Real Natural Earth land is removed from the states, so coastal provinces inherit recognizable coastline edges. Internal boundaries are original nearest-seed approximations, not scientific Longhurst geometry, and do not support area or boundary measurement.
svg.metadata: Original OSW nearest-seed state geometry, MIT licensed. Coast edges use public-domain Natural Earth 1:110m land geometry, commit ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19, SHA-256 9e0729ee253ca7d7a5c4ae9395fb1902264c5377c52e224d13dd85010e2835d9, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson. Province seeds are approximate geographic placements; no geographic Longhurst boundary dataset is reproduced. Region system: osw-regions-v0.1, provisional OSW organizational construct; connected before land masking and projection interruption.
svg.text: 11 ORGANIZATIONAL REALMS · 22 CONTIGUOUS SCHEMATIC REGIONS · 56 CLASSIC PROVINCE IDENTITIES
